caption: Mount Olympus, Litochoro
composition: Rocky path toward Stefani and Mytikas · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: On the summit approach above the Plateau of the Muses, a cairned path of bare limestone leads toward the amphitheater of Stefani and the higher summit of Mytikas. The night is mainly clear, about -2.3°C at the high model cell, with a light wind and no precipitation. The south faces are in moonlight. No snowfield was added, because the model did not report snow.
